evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-14"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-14", a date with no time. POST without dueDate returned 201 with no dueDate field.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 200 with the new date. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 and the dueDate was gone.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30" returned 400. POST with "15.10.2026" returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" returned 400. PATCH with "abc" returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-15. I created todos due yesterday, today, and 2026-12-01, one with no due date, and one done todo due 2026-01-01. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the todo due 2026-10-14. The todos due today or later, the one with no due date, and the done one were all excluded.
evidence.AC5: The page at / showed "(fällig: 14.10.2026)", "(fällig: 15.10.2026)", "(fällig: 01.12.2026)" and "(fällig: 01.01.2026)" next to the matching todos. The todo with no due date showed none.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot only the "past" todo (due 14.10.2026, not done) carried the text "überfällig". The today, future, no-due-date and done-past todos had no marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". Clicking it reduced the list to the single overdue todo, "past".
